text:
What deceits, Celia, what follies are stirred
by blind error, madder than blindness,
if while I compete with fire
you study how to outdo white snow;


if you give wandering gold to the light breeze,
while I surrender my freedom to its error,
or then compete with the wanton vine,
reducing it to so many little rings?


Beware lest the harsh serpent of future age
break the one you have now,
before you lose the fruit of your April.


Would you not laugh at spring
if with useless pomp it denied us fruit
to enjoy the flowers forever?

translation.title: What Deceits, Celia, What Follies...
